title: Hainanese Chicken Bowl
description: A classic Malaysian dish featuring poached chicken and fragrant rice.
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken stock, ginger, and pandan leaves.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add chicken breast to the pot and poach for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove chicken from the pot and let cool.
In a separate pot, steam rice according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together coconut milk and a pinch of salt and pepper.
To assemble the bowl, place a scoop of steamed rice at the bottom, followed by sliced chicken, and drizzle with coconut milk mixture.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
